description:
Create a new appointment group in the Calendar Scheduler for 'Oral Proficiency Exams' in the SPAN101 course. Configure it with the following settings:
- Name: 'Oral Proficiency Exams'
- Location: 'Language Lab 101'
- Select Course: SPAN101 (Elementary Spanish I)
- Duration: 15 minutes per slot
- Limit each time slot to 1 user (Check 'Limit each time slot to 1 user')
- Date: Any date exactly 7 days from today
- Time Range: 14:00 to 16:00 (2:00 PM to 4:00 PM)

Log in as admin (canvas@example.edu / canvas-docker). Navigate to the Calendar, use the Scheduler/Appointment Group tool to create and publish this group.
